name.es-ES: Compendio de la Introducción del símbolo de la fe
name.en-US: Compendium of the Introduction to the Creed
name.pt-BR: Compêndio da Introdução do símbolo da fé

description.es-ES: Compendio de Fray Luis de Granada (1585, dedicado al archiduque Alberto) de la Introducción del símbolo de la fe en cuatro partes, con el Breve tratado del modo de catequizar a los nuevos convertidos.
description.en-US: Fray Luis de Granada's compendium (1585, dedicated to Archduke Albert) of the Introduction to the Creed, in four parts, with the short treatise on how to catechize new converts.
description.pt-BR: Compêndio de Frei Luís de Granada (1585) da Introdução do símbolo da fé, em quatro partes, com o Breve tratado do modo de catequizar os recém-convertidos.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 9 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Text of the 1585 Compendio.
sources.description: Prologue, dedication, four parts of the Compendio (the so-called fifth part of the Símbolo) and the Breve tratado del modo de catequizar. Cuervo's tables are not imported. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
